commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' FC Koln failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+4' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
90+2' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) replaces Hiroki Ito.
85' Substitution. Youssoupha Niang (1. FC Koln) on for Jan Thielmann.
84' 1 - 3 Goal! Luis Diaz plays a short, square pass into the path of Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich), who bends a shot straight into the bottom left corner to make it 1:3. Fabulous goal!

83' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) wastes a huge opportunity after receiving a fine cross from the free kick, but his close-range shot goes well over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
83' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bayern Munich.
82' Here comes a substitution. Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) is brought on as a substitute for Michael Olise.
79' The attendance for today's match is 50000.
78' It will be a substitution. Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) is ready to enter the pitch as Said El Mala walks off.
78' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to substitute Ragnar Ache and he is replaced by Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln).
78' Kristoffer Lund comes off the pitch to be replaced by Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln).
78' 6:17 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
75' A dangerous looking corner kick from Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) is cleared to safety by the defence.
75' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
71' 1 - 2 Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) finds some space inside the box and scores with a crashing header into the roof of the net, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
71' Bayern Munich take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
69' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
67' A substitution has been made. Jonathan Tah goes off and Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) comes on.
67' Vincent Kompany has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) replacing Serge Gnabry.
67' That's the end of the game for Linton Maina, who is replaced by Fynn Schenten (1. FC Koln).

64' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball has crossed the sideline. FC Koln are taking a throw-in.
63' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) attempts to find Konrad Laimer with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
61' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
59' Dangerous play by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich). Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) meets a precise pass with a nice touch on the edge of the box and produces a shot to the middle of the goal. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
57' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

55' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the bottom left corner. His effort is blocked by Marvin Schwabe with a brilliant diving save!
54' Wonderful movement by Bayern Munich. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
53' The ratio of the ball possession is 26:74.
50' Bayern Munich have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
48' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) fires the resulting free kick on goal from a medium range, but sees his shot saved by the goalkeeper.
47' Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln) commits a rough foul. Patrick Ittrich stops the game and makes a call. That's a free kick to Bayern Munich.
46' Referee Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+13' The match has reached half-time.
45+11' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
45+10' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
45+7' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) is penalised for a foul. Patrick Ittrich had a clear view and blows his whistle.
45+5' 1 - 1 Goal! Michael Olise produces a great pass that finds Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot high into the net. 1:1.

45+3' Nice move, nice attempt! Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.

45+2' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Patrick Ittrich with no other option than to blow for a foul.
45+1' The corner is swung in but Bayern Munich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45' We will have 11 min. of added time.
44' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.

41' 1 - 0 Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) goes on a mazy run, perfectly slipping past the opposition's defence. He aims well and places a precise effort behind the goalkeeper! Wonderful goal! Total football.
39' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayern Munich comes to nothing.

39' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
37' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayern Munich.
36' Now FC Koln have a corner. A long pass, executed by Jahmai Simpson-Pusey (1. FC Koln), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
35' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
34' Bayern Munich take a short corner kick.

34' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the left post, but Marvin Schwabe has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bayern Munich.
33' Cenk Ozkacar (1. FC Koln) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Patrick Ittrich blows for a foul.
32' Flag goes up against Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
30' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
27' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
26' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
25' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln).

24' The rebound finds Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) in space inside the box, but his shot goes well wide of the right post. That was a promising chance! The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.

21' Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Marvin Schwabe guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
20' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
19' That's unlucky! Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
17' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Linton Maina (1. FC Koln), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
14' Patrick Ittrich couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) and blew his whistle.
13' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
5' The game is interrupted.

2' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Manuel Neuer shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
